messages:
anya: Quick sync — thinking about token counter behavior in the compact chat while streaming. Right now it jumps position and obscures actions. Thoughts on safer placements?

mike: My vote: attach a tiny badge to the generated message bubble (bottom-right). Keeps it contextual and avoids the rail flicker.

dani: Bubble badge seems nice but we need a clear tap target for touch. Maybe 24px hit area, visually 14px. Also must be readable at 100% zoom.

sanjay: Accessibility notes: badge must be reachable via keyboard (tab) and announced properly. Proposed aria: `aria-label=\"Tokens used 88 of 2048\"` and `role=\"button\"` so users can open a token details panel.

oliver: What about the control wording? We have 3 states: streaming, interrupted, finished. Button currently says \"Stop\". Should it be \"Abort\"? \"Stop\"? \"Interrupt\"?

anya: User testing bias says \"Stop\" is familiar, but ambiguous. \"Abort\" feels harsh. Alternative: keep label as \"Stop\" and provide persistent tooltip: \"Stop generation (can regenerate partial output)\".

dani: For the regenerate CTA, UX team prefers \"Try again\" for novices. Engineering folks prefer \"Regenerate\". Can we show \"Try again\" and in smaller meta text show \"(regenerate)\"?

mike: Meta text risks clutter. Another idea: primary button text = \"Try again\"; beneath it show a microcopy line `Regenerate with same prompt` in the action sheet.

sanjay: Also ensure focus management: when user presses Stop, focus should move to the first post-stop action (Try again). If user triggered Stop via keyboard, they should be able to press Enter to immediately regenerate. Add `aria-pressed` to indicate stream state.

anya: Good call. Dani — can you draft the focus flow? We need to avoid focus loss when the bubble is removed/updated during stream.

dani: I'll sketch a flow: 1) Stop pressed -> emit `live-region` text: \"Generation stopped. Partial output available.\" 2) Move focus to action group container with `tabindex=\"-1\"` then focus. 3) Action buttons have clear labels and `aria-describedby` linking to microcopy about caching.

oliver: Microcopy suggestion for cache state: if prefix cache is warm, show small toast: \"Cached: quick regenerate available\" vs cold: \"Regenerating may take longer\". Avoid exposing TTL numbers.

mike: UI animation: instead of badge teleporting, fade + slide from 4px. CSS prototype: `.token-badge{transition:transform .14s ease, opacity .12s ease; transform:translateY(0)}` and when streaming change translateY to keep layout stable.

anya: Prompt library tie-in: when user clicks token badge, would it make sense to surface prompts that reduce token usage (shorten prompt)? Maybe a quick suggestion: \"Trim prompt\" -> open prompt library variant showing compressed templates.

dani: Love it. We'll need a simple affordance: burger menu inside badge -> \"Optimize prompt\" opens quick panel prefilled with suggestions. Keep it optional.

sanjay: Telemetry plan: log tokenBadgeOpened, optimizePromptClicked, stopAction, regenAction, a11yFocusMoved. Keep event payloads minimal.

ui-bot: Created experiment `playground.miniplay.tokenBadge` (#PL-5024). Variants: bubble_badge, rail_badge. Rollout default 5%. Events: tokenBadgeShown, tokenBadgeTapped, stopPressed, regenerateTapped, optimizePromptOpened, a11yLiveAnnounced.

anya: Let's run a small prototype in figma + a1 clickable and collect qualitative feedback from 8 designers + 12 PMs/engineers. Dani — can you add copy variants in figma: 1) Stop + tooltip 'can regenerate', 2) Interrupt + tooltip 'pauses generation', 3) Abort (not recommended).

dani: On it. I'll also include the microcopy for the token details panel: header 'Token usage', body 'This message used 88 tokens of your model limit (2048). Tips: remove long context, use short templates.'

mike: One last nit: color contrast for badge text at small sizes. Ensure AA contrast vs bg. If we use 12px white text on colored pill, check ratios.

sanjay: I'll add an accessibility checklist to the PR: focus order, aria labels, live region phrasing, contrast ratios, hit area sizes.

anya: Sweet. Wrap-up: Dani creates figma frames + copy variants; Mike makes CSS prototype; Sanjay writes a11y checklist and telemetry spec; I'll coordinate the experiment. Meeting in two days to review results. :white_check_mark:
